title: AquaTerra in July 2025: {count} drives, Roots tees and clothes
description: July 2025 at AquaTerra: {count} drives, Roots tee days at three schools, six Wear and Share clothes collections, workshops at Pather Sathi and an animal welfare seminar.
lede: In July 2025 AquaTerra ran {count} drives with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts, and the month had a different shape from June. Roots tee days ran at three schools, six Wear and Share clothes collections moved stop by stop across the city, four workshops ran at Pather Sathi in the second half, and a feeding drive and an animal welfare seminar filled out the rest.

sections.heading: roots tees on school days
body: Three schools hosted a run of two-day events in July where students wore Roots tees. Morpheus was at South City International School on 3 and 4 July, Concord at Calcutta Boys School on 7 and 8 July, and Confluence at Calcutta International School on 25 and 26 July. The Roots tees come from [Crftd](/crftd), AquaTerra's student streetwear label, which was earlier called Roots.

The write-ups count a few hundred walk-ins on each of those days, and they describe students wearing the tees with pride. Each day was run by a small team, so a school day is a useful way to reach a lot of people with a modest group.

sections.heading: wear and share, stop by stop
body: Wear and Share ran six clothes collection drives in July, numbered 17.0 to 22.0. They went to Natural City in Laketown on 9 July, Club Town Greens and Salt Lake on 10 July, Avani Oxford and Howrah AC on 12 July, and Bangur on 13 July.

The clothes gathered ran from five kilograms at Bangur to a range of ten to fifteen kilograms at Salt Lake and Natural City, as the write-ups give them. Each stop is written up separately, so a new member can see how the same format works in a different neighbourhood. [How to run a clothes donation drive](/impact/how-to-run-a-clothes-donation-drive) sets out the steps.

sections.heading: workshops at Pather Sathi
body: Four workshops at Pather Sathi came in the last two weeks of July: Fun Fusion on 18 July, Joy Jam on 19 July, Happy Hands on 25 July and Tiny Tales on 26 July. Tiny Tales mixed drawing and quizzing, Joy Jam was about brightening lives through education and care, and Fun Fusion aimed to teach hope, one child at a time.
Pawtect, an animal welfare seminar at MCKV Institute of Technology on 17 July, was the month's talk on kindness. It advocated protection for animals, and children were among those taught.

sections.heading: feeding and book collections
body: Tails and Treats 41.0 ran once in July, on 11 July at Avani Oxford, where students fed biscuits to street dogs as part of the [Tails and Treats](/impact/tails-and-treats) series. The write-up says 50 dogs fed, with a team of three.

Book Basket collections 14.0, 15.0 and 16.0 ran in the same month at Salt Lake and Kolkata on 4 July and at Ashoka Building on 8 July. They are small collections, and they show the book drive running alongside everything else in the month.

learnings: A school day with a clear product, such as the Roots tees, drew a few hundred walk-ins on each day of its two-day event.
Running the same clothes collection across six neighbourhoods in one month makes the format easy to copy in a new place.
Pather Sathi workshops came in a tight run over two weeks, so a member who joins in a month like this will see a steady rhythm there.
Not every series runs every month: July had one feeding drive, so the month was built around school days and clothes instead.

faqs.q: What did AquaTerra do in July 2025?
faqs.a: In July 2025 AquaTerra ran {count} drives with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts. The month was built around Roots tee days at three schools, six Wear and Share clothes collections, four workshops at Pather Sathi, an animal welfare seminar, a feeding drive and a run of Book Basket collections.

faqs.q: What are Roots tees and where were they worn in July 2025?
faqs.a: Roots tees come from Crftd, AquaTerra's student streetwear label, which was earlier called Roots. In July 2025 they were worn at South City International School for Morpheus, at Calcutta Boys School for Concord and at Calcutta International School for Confluence.

faqs.q: Where did Wear and Share collect clothes in July 2025?
faqs.a: Wear and Share ran six clothes collection drives in July 2025, numbered 17.0 to 22.0. The stops were Natural City in Laketown, Club Town Greens, Salt Lake, Avani Oxford, Howrah AC and Bangur.

faqs.q: Did AquaTerra feed dogs or hold an animal welfare seminar in July 2025?
faqs.a: Yes to both. Tails and Treats 41.0 fed street dogs at Avani Oxford on 11 July, and the Pawtect animal welfare seminar at MCKV Institute of Technology on 17 July promoted kindness and protection for animals.
